name: election-results
title: Election Results
description: Follow live election results from your menu bar, get notified as the count comes in, and ask Raycast AI about them.
author: clins1994

commands.name: elections
commands.title: Browse Elections
commands.subtitle: Brazil
commands.description: Every election, newest first. Open one for its live results, or pick the one the menu bar shows.

commands.name: election-results
commands.title: Election Results Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Brazil
commands.description: Live Brazilian election results in the menu bar, with a notification when results come in.

preferences.name: notify
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.description: Plays a sound and shows a macOS notification on big moments
preferences.label: Notify when results come in, the lead changes, or a winner is declared

tools.name: list-elections
tools.title: List Elections
tools.description: List the elections this extension has results for, newest first, with their ids and voting windows.

tools.name: get-election-results
tools.title: Get Election Results
tools.description: Get one election's official results: phase, share counted, candidates with party, running mate, votes, share and outcome, the winner, and the gap between the first two.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
